The div-guard block after it stays asm on evidence: its final j leaves the frame allocated with $ra never reloaded - not C tail-call codegen.

unknown_function 20->23 (2026-10-11): three trivial functions matched across three targets (first C functions for g3_jp, mainmenu_jp; g3_eu second): two empty void bodies (g3_jp 0x800629A0, g3_eu 0x80062280) and one return-4th-arg getter (mainmenu_jp 0x800791A4). 23 = 20 + 3 auto-named definitions, no externs (no callees). The getter needed a third cc_post rule: cc1 fills the return jump's delay slot with the value move, retail keeps it before the jump with a nop delay slot.

unknown_function 23->85, unknown_data 4->8 (2026-10-11): mainmenu_eu wrapper family matched through the round-trip oracle - the whole 0x2c8 cluster at 0x800379E4 as one C unit (16 void wrappers over the menu-state flag D_800C936C, the sequence helper func_80035664 and the menu primitive func_80025CFC; first C functions for mainmenu_eu). 85 = 23 + 16 definitions + 2 extern declarations + 31 call sites (16+15) + 11 comment references; 8 = 4 + 1 extern + 2 stores + 1 comment mention. cc_post gained rule 4 (prologue save restore) and build.sh gained -G0 + gp_value-gated gp_rel rewrite (bare-symbol externs now expand to retail's absolute lui/$at form on non-gp targets). Three scanned head/tail pairs (B40+B60, B6C+B7C, B98+BA4) are whole C functions; their mid-function entry labels resolve by address via the two-pass auto-definition.
